description:
Use this when the user asks for Indian stocks matching numeric criteria such as PE, PB, market cap, ROE, margins or debt, optionally within an index such as NIFTY 50. For OR logic or arithmetic between metrics use screen_by_query.

Returns up to `limit` securities (default 25, at most 100) that meet every filter, sorted by `sort_by` (default market_cap) in `order` ("desc" or "asc"), with the filtered metrics on each row. `filters` is an object. A range filter is a metric name ending in `_min` or `_max`, and the unit depends on the metric. Fractions, where 0.15 means 15%: roe, roa, roce, net_margin, ebitda_margin, operating_margin, dividend_yield, earnings_yield, fcf_yield, revenue_growth, net_income_growth, return_1d to return_1y, the 3- and 5-year growth rates, pct_off_52w_low. Percentages, where 50 means 50%: promoter_pct, pledged_pct, deliv_pct, and the quarterly change in promoter, FII, DII and public holding, in percentage points. Rupees: market_cap, ev, price, turnover, week52_high, week52_low (Rs 5,000 crore is 50000000000). Plain numbers: pe, pb, debt_to_equity, interest_coverage, ev_to_ebitda, price_to_sales, price_to_cash_flow, piotroski_f_score (0 to 9). Exact filters take one value: sector, industry, igroup, isubgroup, company_type (general, bank, nbfc, insurer), index (an index name such as "NIFTY 50") and is_sme (true or false). A name that is not recognised returns the closest valid names in place of an empty result. More metrics are accepted than are listed here: an unknown key returns an error that lists them all. A security with no value for a filtered metric is left out and counted in `excluded_missing_metric`; margin, debt and enterprise-value metrics have no value for banks, NBFCs and insurers.

filters.description: Object of criteria, AND-combined, e.g. {"market_cap_min": 50000000000, "pe_max": 20} (market cap is in rupees). Range filters take a `_min` or `_max` suffix.
filters.title: Filters
